Governance Results for 742 Birchwood Ave ( https://www.lofty.ai/property_deal/742-Birchwood-Ave_Springfield-Illinois-62704 ):

The Governance Voting results are back for the owner-proposed vote to lower the asking sale price of the property from $250,000 to $190,000 to speed up the sale of the property.

The winning vote is:

Yes, lower the listing price to $190,000.

This option received 2,000 / 2,500 token votes which is equal to 80.0% of the total votes.

The listing agent advised he received an offer of $150,000. We are currently waiting on more information on the offer before sending out a governance vote to investors to accept, counter, or deny
the offer.
